explanation: Three rank-8 closed-form subspace edits, derived only from frozen weights and unedited activations: attenuate guess-dependent answer copying in layer 19 attention, and reinforce condition-stable factual retrieval in layer 20 linear attention and layer 21 MLP. Shared condition/format means were excluded. Gains (-1.0, +1.0, +1.3) were calibrated using exact local projection effects and logit-lens margin estimates, including alternate phrasings, plain/correct-guess controls, reply openings, bold answers, and second-digit positions. No gradients, optimization, or edited-model forward passes were used.
